name: Hair In The City
lead: A Keune Gold Ambassador salon on Glasgow's oldest street, renowned for signature balayage, lived-in blondes, advanced colour rescues and the safest extensions.

experience.title: Your hair's integrity comes first
experience.text: Our passionate, highly trained team listen and guide you through a thorough consultation, giving you an honest, professional opinion. Led by Salon Director Louise Wilson, a former professional colour educator with over 25 years in hairdressing.

currency_note: All prices are from and confirmed on consultation.

special.title: A private room, at no extra cost
special.text: Our fully enclosed private hairdressing room gives a secure, female-only space for hijab-friendly appointments, or simply for anyone who'd like more privacy.

reviews: I’ve been coming to Hair in the City for 10+ years and wouldn’t trust anyone else with my hair. The salon is professional and friendly.
I’ve been coming here regularly for highlights and always have such a great experience. Everyone at the salon is so welcoming and friendly, and Louise is absolutely amazing.
It’s always such a pleasure coming to Hair in the City, but tonight was the first time I had the privilege of a restyle by Louise. I had a particular style in mind, and she absolutely nailed it.

I've been going to Hair in the City for a long time now and I always leave feeling great. Louise and her team give honest advice about styles and also help advise how to style your hair at home (this involved teaching me how to blow dry my hair).

audit.title: What hairinthecity.co.uk is costing you, and what this fixes.
fixes: One tap to call you, on every page.
Built light, so it opens in about a second on a phone.
